title: Change-management master index
description: company-profile/<company_id>/change_management/master.json: the index of every remediation initiative for one company. Feeds the cm_coverage, cm_time_to_implementation and incident_rate KPIs, so owner, approvedAt, dueAt, closedAt, slaBasis and regulatoryRefs must always be populated. Per-initiative detail lives in initiatives/<init_id>/timeline.json and tasks/task_<n>.json

initiatives.title: Generate and retain CycloneDX SBOMs in the trading-gateway CI pipeline
initiatives.summary: SEBI CSCRF GV.SC.S5 requires a software bill of materials for critical systems; the trading-gateway build produces none today
initiatives.rollbackPlan: Revert PR #482 on trading-gateway-api; the build workflow returns to its previous definition and no runtime component is affected
initiatives.riskAssessment: Low: adds a post-build CI job only; a failing SBOM step blocks the pipeline but not the running service

companyId.description: Slug of the company this index belongs to; must equal the company-profile directory name

updatedAt.description: When this index was last rewritten. Must be >= every initiative's createdAt and the latest closedAt

counters.description: Derived roll-up over initiatives[], recomputed on every write. open + closed + cancelled == initiatives.length. KPIs count status == closed only: cancelled initiatives are excluded from cm_time_to_implementation, SLA compliance and the incident_rate denominator

open.description: Number of initiatives whose status is not closed or cancelled

closed.description: Number of initiatives whose status is closed; the only ones the KPIs count as implemented

cancelled.description: Number of initiatives whose status is cancelled; excluded from every KPI

overdue.description: Number of open initiatives whose dueAt is earlier than updatedAt (SLA breached)

initiatives.description: Every initiative ever raised for the company, including closed and cancelled ones. initiativeId must be unique across the array

priority.description: Scheduling priority set by the change manager (vocab statuses priority)

slaBasis.description: Which rule produced dueAt, mirroring soc finding.slaBasis. source sla-table: the (instrument, topic, severity) row of .claude/skills/regulatory-catalogs/references/sla-table.json, instrument required; defaults: the table's per-severity defaults because no row matched; company-policy: a company-override from sdlc/policy.json. days is copied from that source so dueAt = createdAt + days can be audited

source.description: Where days came from: sla-table row, sla-table defaults fallback, or company-policy override

instrument.description: Instrument whose SLA table row was applied; required when source is sla-table

controlId.description: Control within the instrument whose SLA row was applied, when the table is per control

topic.description: SLA-table topic that was looked up (the row key together with instrument and severity)

days.description: Calendar days allowed from createdAt to closedAt under the cited source

taskCounts.description: Derived roll-up over initiatives/<init_id>/tasks/task_<n>.json, recomputed whenever a task file changes

total.description: Number of task files under the initiative, all statuses included

done.description: Number of tasks with status done

blocked.description: Number of tasks with status blocked

initiative.description: One remediation initiative (ITIL 4 change). Lifecycle: proposed -> approved -> in-progress -> (blocked) -> verifying -> closed; cancelled or reopened at any point after proposed. approvedAt and approver are forbidden while proposed and required from approved onward (approved, in-progress, blocked, verifying, closed, reopened); a standard change is pre-authorised, so record the policy as approver (type script or human) and approvedAt = createdAt. rollbackPlan and plannedWindow are required for normal and emergency changes from approved onward. closedAt is required exactly when status is closed or cancelled

initiativeId.description: Prefixed ULID; also the directory name under change_management/initiatives/

title.description: Imperative one-line title of the change, e.g. 'Generate SBOMs in CI'

summary.description: One or two sentences on why the change is needed and what it delivers

status.description: Current lifecycle state; every transition must also be recorded as an event in the initiative timeline

severity.description: Highest severity among the linked findings and risks

changeType.description: ITIL 4 change type: standard (pre-authorised, low risk), normal (needs approval), emergency (expedited approval)

owner.description: Accountable person or agent; a human owner is expected before the initiative leaves proposed

approver.description: Who approved the change (CAB member, CISO, ECAB for emergency; the pre-authorising policy script for a standard change). Required from approved onward, forbidden while proposed

createdAt.description: When the initiative was raised. Starts the SLA clock (dueAt = createdAt + slaBasis.days) but not the cm_time_to_implementation clock, which starts at approvedAt

approvedAt.description: When the approver authorised the change; for a standard change equal to createdAt. Start of the cm_time_to_implementation clock (median of closedAt - approvedAt over initiatives with status closed). Required from approved onward, forbidden while proposed

dueAt.description: SLA deadline = createdAt + slaBasis.days. SLA compliance = closedAt <= dueAt for status closed; while open, overdue = dueAt < updatedAt. Cancelled initiatives are excluded

rollbackPlan.description: Documented back-out plan (ITIL 4, RBI IT Governance MD 2023, SEBI CSCRF): how to restore the previous state if implementation or verification fails. Required for normal and emergency changes from approved onward; not used by any KPI

riskAssessment.description: Assessed risk of making the change (blast radius, downtime, data impact) and any mitigations; recommended for normal and emergency changes. Not used by any KPI

closedAt.description: When the initiative reached closed or cancelled. Only status closed feeds the KPIs: cm_time_to_implementation = closedAt - approvedAt and SLA compliance = closedAt <= dueAt for closed initiatives; cancelled ones are excluded from both and from the incident_rate denominator. Remove it when reopening

findingIds.description: Ledger findings this initiative remediates; empty only for proactive changes

controlIds.description: Ids of control records in the company's soc ledger that the initiative implements or strengthens (same meaning as controlIds on soc records); each must exist in the ledger and should correspond to a regulatoryRefs entry. Joined by cm_coverage

regulatoryRefs.description: At least one regulatory clause justifying the change; the most specific Indian instrument first

targets.description: Assets the change touches (applications, environments, repos, images, vendors)

suggestionIds.description: Auto-improvement suggestions (suggestions/master.json) raised to implement this initiative

sourceWorkflow.description: Workflow that raised the initiative (usually impl-change-management or a report-* workflow)

provenance.description: Provenance of this initiative entry, distinct from the index-level provenance

plannedWindow.description: Implementation window agreed at approval (ITIL 4 change schedule); required for normal and emergency changes once approved

end.description: Latest moment implementation must be complete or rolled back; never later than dueAt
